title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The Decision of the AI Office outlines the official stance and guidelines set by the AI Office on how AI systems should be deployed and governed. It serves as a reference for ensuring responsible AI practices and compliance across the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy document outlines the creation of an office vacancy for technology specialists in AI, detailing the roles and responsibilities required for these positions. It sets guidelines for recruitment, qualifications, and how these specialists will support the organization’s AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This document announces a vacancy for the position of Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. The role involves overseeing scientific strategy and providing expert guidance on AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy outlines the roles and responsibilities of legal officers within the AI office vacancy, focusing on overseeing AI compliance, risk, and governance. It provides guidelines for these officers to monitor AI deployments, ensure regulatory adherence, and manage legal risks associated with AI technologies.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy outlines the qualifications and duties for Policy Officers in the AI Office, focusing on expertise in AI ethics, governance, and compliance. It also details the hiring process, performance expectations, and accountability mechanisms for these officers.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts assembled to advise lawmakers on the European AI Act. It examines AI risks, safety, and regulatory options, providing evidence‑based recommendations to shape policy.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The document is a draft request to standardise AI development and deployment practices. It outlines procedures for creating and adopting common standards, ensuring consistency, safety, and compliance across AI systems.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice informs stakeholders that a community of practice (CoP) is seeking input on its policies and initiatives. It invites feedback and participation from relevant parties to shape the CoP's direction.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This policy document announces a call for individuals to express interest in forming or joining a Community of Practice (CoP) around AI. It outlines how to submit expressions of interest and what the CoP aims to achieve.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This document explains how the CoP Graphic uses an iterative drafting process. It provides an overview of the steps and methods involved in creating the graphic.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document shows a visual timeline that outlines the stages involved in drafting the AI policy, from initial discussion to final review. It highlights key milestones and the roles of various contributors so stakeholders can see how the policy was developed over time.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document presents the first draft of a Code of Practice for the responsible use of AI, outlining core principles such as transparency, fairness, accountability, and safety. It offers practical guidance for organizations to adopt these standards and ensure their AI systems are developed and deployed in an ethical, compliant manner.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: A “Code of Practice: 2nd Draft” is a set of guidelines that aim to shape how artificial intelligence should be developed and used, emphasizing responsible design, transparency, and ethical considerations. It outlines standards and best practices that organizations can follow to ensure AI systems are safe, fair, and aligned with societal values.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents the third draft of a code of practice intended to guide the ethical and responsible use of AI technologies. It provides updated principles, standards, and recommendations for developers, users, and regulators to promote transparency, accountability, and safety in AI deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines proposed guidelines for the ethical development and deployment of artificial intelligence. It aims to bring together stakeholders to agree on principles that promote transparency, accountability, and safety in AI systems.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final outlines the agreed principles and commitments for responsible AI use, focusing on safety, transparency, and collaboration among stakeholders. It sets guidelines for developers, regulators, and users to ensure AI systems are fair, accountable, and aligned with societal values.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy lists the AI actions and applications that are disallowed, helping developers and users avoid unethical or harmful uses. It provides clear examples of prohibited practices to ensure compliance and promote responsible AI deployment.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This document explains what qualifies as an AI system, outlining the technical and functional characteristics that determine whether a system is considered AI. It provides clear criteria for identifying AI, guiding developers, users, and regulators on classification, labeling, and compliance responsibilities.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines how the government will use clear communication channels to support startup development and foster innovation across the economy. It emphasizes the importance of transparent information sharing, collaboration with industry, and targeted outreach to help early‑stage companies access resources and markets.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups aims to give early-stage companies in Europe access to powerful high‑performance computing resources. It provides training, funding, and support to help these startups develop and commercialize new technologies.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This AI policy document is a slideshow presentation for a webinar on risk management. It covers essential strategies for spotting, evaluating, and reducing risks in AI projects.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar covers risk management strategies for AI projects, focusing on how to identify and evaluate potential threats. It discusses practical steps for mitigating those risks to ensure safer, more reliable AI deployment.
